description: Trigger discrimination for role-coverage QA design: allowed-path matrices and cross-role interface deltas versus designing the authorization matrix (authorization-matrix-designer), denial suites (multi-tenant-security-tester, manual-only), product strategy (qa-strategy-architect), per-change plans (test-plan-designer), spec implementation (playwright-e2e-engineer, manual-only), and scripted manual cases (manual-test-case-creator).

cases.prompt: We have the authorization matrix. Which allowed behaviors should each role have covered, at which layer, and where do the same screens differ between roles?
cases.reason: Coverage of the allowed paths and cross-role interface deltas over an EXISTING matrix is this skill; designing the matrix or planning one change is not.

cases.prompt: Design the authorization matrix for our product — roles, grants, and the deny-by-default policy.
cases.reason: Designing roles, grants and the deny-by-default policy is authorization-matrix-designer; this skill consumes its output as input.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke multi-tenant-security-tester. Build the cross-tenant and wrong-role negative suite proving members cannot delete other members' projects.
cases.reason: Denial and negative-permission suites are multi-tenant-security-tester's (manual-only) and authorization-matrix-designer step 7's; this skill covers allowed paths only.

cases.prompt: Decide our QA strategy — which layers we invest in and who owns each.
cases.reason: Product-wide layer investment and ownership is strategy; role coverage is one design inside it.

cases.prompt: Plan the testing for the new roles change — what to test at which layer, with what data, and when testing is done.
cases.reason: A single change's per-layer plan with exit criteria is test-plan-designer; a role-coverage design spans the shipped role set, not one change.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke playwright-e2e-engineer. Write Playwright specs covering each role's checkout journey.
cases.reason: Implementing the E2E specs is playwright-e2e-engineer (manual-only); this skill names the coverage and hands the specs off.

cases.prompt: Write step-by-step manual test cases for the manager role's dashboard with exact data and expected results.
cases.reason: Stranger-executable scripted cases are manual-test-case-creator's output; this skill designs the coverage, not the case steps.

cases.prompt: The same settings screen hides the billing tab for members. Design the cross-role checks that catch menu and field differences like that.
cases.reason: Naming cross-role interface-consistency deltas and their checks is this skill's core; no matrix design or scripted steps are requested.
